tips.text: Farm Animo Nav Beacons on Regna: alert the Corpus outdoors, hack the Ambulas the dropship leaves, then abort or finish.
Bring a wide-area crowd control frame such as Frost, Gara, Vauban, Nyx or Octavia; the defend phase becomes waiting for the timer.
Always have one hacked Ambulas guarded before the next dropship arrives.
Kill the repair drones; they undo your armor-plate progress.
Bring a radiation weapon with punch through so you hit the weak spots whichever way it faces.
Bring Nova to speed up the waves; you cannot shorten the dropship timer, but you spend less of it fighting reinforcements.
Play Limbo or Wukong to zone out through the waiting periods.
Get to the boss room quickly; the fight's timers cannot be skipped, so travel is the only time you control.
Cap yourself at a couple of runs per login so the dull loop does not burn you out.
Switch to the normal Circuit during her rotation week if Systems will not drop; it has no RNG and needs no beacons.
Start each component as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap.
Expect a few hours if Systems cooperates; the Ambulas fight is slow but no longer the old grind.
